evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To address these challenges, we introduce DSV-Mem, a benchmark for evaluating Dense Stateful Visual Memory.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Conversational MLLM agents are increasingly expected to assist in professional workflows, from AI research and engineering design to product management and business operations.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Evaluation over 27 configurations spanning frontier and open-weight models and memory management methods reveals that the strongest baseline scores below 45% on DSV-Mem.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: DSV-Mem comprises expert-reviewed scenarios and 1,000 questions across five user-oriented categories (Current State, Past State, Derived State, Change History, and Conflict/Refusal).
